attributes.title: 2027 WVSCA Conference
attributes.series: West Virginia School Counselor Association Annual Conference
attributes.summary:
The West Virginia School Counselor Association meets on February 25 and 26, 2027, at the Morgantown Marriott at Waterfront Place in Morgantown. The two-day conference runs from 8:00 a.m. on the first day to 3:30 p.m. on the second, with sessions on best practices, evidence-based programming and advocacy for school counselors.

The association says CEUs are available for attendees, with certificates handled through the conference website. The conference pages do not state the number of hours or the approving body, so check with WVSCA if you need a specific credit type for a counseling license or a school certification.

WVSCA members pay $199 through December 18, 2026, and $259 after that; non-members pay $349 and student members $79. Presenters chosen through the call for proposals register at $129 with a code. The registration table runs through February 19, 2027, and the association accepts purchase orders from school districts.
